limitations: R01-R16 scientific requirements remain unaccepted; this PR supplies observation and coverage infrastructure only.

The public dictionary route carries pending proposal assets, while canonical v1.2 has no dictionary promotion; schema applicability and scientific suitability remain unresolved.
Browser/CORS observations are contextual and no browser operation is claimed for this artifact.

Compact observations preserve access_facts and core_contracts. Compact access-summary projections carry evidence IDs; the bound evidence_catalog preserves complete source locators and record/source/field/revision bindings.
